pages.title: How this book works
pages.body: Short reads, then check questions. Correctness is shown here for prototype learning only. When you want the full student path, open live diagnosis.

pages.title: Linear equations
pages.body: Isolate the variable with inverse operations. Keep both sides honest — whatever you do to one side, do to the other.

pages.title: Functions basics
pages.body: f(x) is a machine. Drop in x, follow the rule, read the output. Start with linear rules before graphs.

pages.title: Ratios
pages.body: A ratio compares parts. Cross-multiply when one part is missing — or scale both sides by the same factor.

pages.title: Check · ratios
pages.stem: Sugar to flour is 2:5. With 10 cups of flour, how much sugar?
